# Draft:Nalluri Vigneswar

Nalluri Vigneswar is an Indian artificial intelligence developer and the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of Fraylon Technologies, a technology startup focused on AI-driven applications and digital solutions.
Early life and education
Nalluri Vigneswar is pursuing a Bachelor of Technology in Artificial Intelligence. He has maintained a consistent academic record and has shown interest in emerging technologies, particularly artificial intelligence and software development.
Career
Vigneswar serves as the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of Fraylon Technologies. In this role, he is responsible for leading the technical strategy of the company, overseeing development processes, and contributing to the creation of AI-driven solutions.
His work focuses on artificial intelligence, scalable systems, and modern web technologies. He has also gained practical experience through internships in full-stack development, working on real-world applications involving frontend and backend technologies.
Fraylon Technologies
Fraylon Technologies is a technology startup focused on building AI-based applications and digital solutions. The company is led by Chalamalapalli Ram Teja (CEO) and Nalluri Vigneswar (CTO). It aims to develop scalable systems and explore practical applications of artificial intelligence across different domains.
